Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with cancer indications. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Filter where max_phase_for_ind = 4 and mesh_heading contains 'cancer'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
